title: Nourishing Delicate Dutch Fiordilatte Pasta
description: A fresh and tender Dutch dish featuring fiordilatte, perfect for a date night, cooked in a cataplana vessel with dashi extract for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the cataplana pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a small saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the dashi extract to the saucepan and stir to combine.
In a large cataplana vessel, combine the cooked pasta, fiordilatte, garlic and dashi mixture, and toss to combine.
Season with salt, black pepper, and lemon zest, and toss again to combine.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Ensure the cataplana vessel is heated over low heat to prevent the fiordilatte from melting too quickly.
Use a thermometer to check the internal temperature of the dish, ensuring it reaches a safe minimum of 145 degrees.
